prompts.oak: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: seamless repeating opaque photographic texture for a web page background under a parchment scroll. Create one square full-frame texture tile of an aged oak tabletop, warm muted medium-brown oak, straight vertical fine wood grain, restrained irregular pores, subtle wear and fine scratches, broad continuous timber surface. Orthographic camera exactly overhead, flat planar wood filling all pixels. Soft perfectly even diffuse lighting, matte natural finish, low contrast, museum furniture feel, tangible photographic micro-detail rather than a game illustration. Critical: genuinely seamless wrap in both horizontal and vertical directions: grain and color must continue naturally across left/right and top/bottom edges with no visible line when copies repeat. No large knots, no plank seams, no distinctive stain or objects, no perspective, no table edges, no vignette, no bright center or dark border, no text, no watermark, no border, no mirrored or kaleidoscopic grain. Grain scale appropriate to a realistic tabletop viewed under a document. Produce a single square tile, not a contact sheet or tiling preview.
